name: Short Cut Sweet Kale Chopped Salad with Plant-Based "Turkey" & Apple

instructions.primary_message: Place the contents of each salad kit in a medium bowl (reserving dressing and topping packets).
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (340 g) pkg sweet kale chopped salad kit

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, quarter, and core apple; thinly slice. Medium dice plant-based turkey. Add both to the bowl with the salad along with dressing and toppings. Toss to combine the salad, seasoning with salt and pepper to taste.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 Granny Smith apple
1 (156 g) pkg plant-based deli turkey, sliced

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
